slots.name: structure height
slots.sentence: Brendan George’s new play, “ The Vessel ,” is set at the climbable, 150-foot-tall latticework structure of the same name, which opened at the Hudson Yards luxury development on the West Side of Manhattan in 2019 .

slots.name: worker count
slots.sentence: Three workers at a towering Manhattan tourist attraction watch for visitors intent on self-harm in this new play by Brendan George.

slots.name: hourly wage
slots.sentence: Answering tourists’ questions is part of the $15-an-hour gig.

slots.name: running time
slots.sentence: The Vessel Through Aug. 23 at 59E59 Theaters, Manhattan; 59e59.org . Running time: 1 hour 30 minutes.

slots.name: number of scenes
slots.sentence: It would be helpful for the audience to know, for example, that each of the play’s three scenes occurs on a day that a visitor, in real life, died at the “Vessel.”
